en: The New Bodhisattva Sūtra:
[Leading] □□□□□□□, with a total of one million recitations of the Great and Small Mindfulnesses.
Among the five hundred bodies of Amitābha Buddha, he does not enter □□. The Bodhisattva now speaks these eight, nine, and ten [verses].
When Mount Tai collapses, it requires nine trillion [bricks] and also nine thousand billion oxen.
The first calamity is death;
the second is sudden death.
Third, death while sitting in labor;
fourth, death from failing to observe the fast;
fifth, death from a fever in the intestines and abdomen.
Sixth, suicide by hanging.
Now, as the grain and beans ripen, I fear there will be no harvest and nothing to eat.
If you write out one copy of this letter now while the harvest is good, you may save yourself from calamity.
If one writes [the name] twice, the entire family is exempted;
if one writes it thrice, the entire village is exempted.
If it is heard that one does not write it, then the lineage will be extinguished.
If there are those who recite this sutra,
they shall all be delivered from suffering and hardship;
those who do not believe shall perish in this very body.
The scripture came from the commandery of Xiliangzhou;
it was found at the eastern gate of that city,
where amidst thunder and rain, a stone as large as a peck-measure fell.
It was split into two pieces, and upon opening them, this scripture was found.
By circulating and showing it to sentient beings, one shall obtain immeasurable merit.
The fifteenth day of the fourth month in the fifth year of the Chang'an era.
